/-- The maximal separated set is a cover. -/
lemma isCover_maximalSeparatedSet (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    IsCover ε A (maximalSeparatedSet ε A) := by
  refine .of_maximal_isSeparated ⟨⟨maximalSeparatedSet_subset, isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet⟩,
    fun N hN hsub ↦ ?_⟩
  have hfin : (maximalSeparatedSet ε A).Finite :=
    Set.encard_ne_top_iff.mp ((card_maximalSeparatedSet h).trans_ne h)
  exact (hfin.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le hsub
    ((hN.2.encard_le_packingNumber hN.1).trans (card_maximalSeparatedSet h).ge)).ge

lemma card_le_of_isSeparated (h_subset : C ⊆ A)
    (h_sep : IsSeparated ε C) (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    C.encard ≤ (maximalSeparatedSet ε A).encard :=
  (h_sep.encard_le_packingNumber h_subset).trans_eq (card_maximalSeparatedSet h).symm

theorem coveringNumber_le_packingNumber (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Set X) :
    coveringNumber ε A ≤ packingNumber ε A := by
  by_cases h_top : packingNumber ε A = ⊤
  · simp [h_top]
  exact ((isCover_maximalSeparatedSet h_top).coveringNumber_le_encard
    maximalSeparatedSet_subset).trans_eq (card_maximalSeparatedSet h_top)

theorem coveringNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Set X) :
    coveringNumber (2 * ε) A ≤ externalCoveringNumber ε A :=
  (coveringNumber_le_packingNumber _ A).trans (packingNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber ε A)

lemma exists_set_encard_eq_coveringNumber (h : coveringNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ C, C ⊆ A ∧ C.Finite ∧ IsCover ε A C ∧ C.encard = coveringNumber ε A := by
  have : Nonempty { s : Set X // s ⊆ A ∧ IsCover ε A s } := ⟨⟨A, subset_rfl, .rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ENat.exists_eq_iInf
    (fun C : { s : Set X // s ⊆ A ∧ IsCover ε A s } ↦ (C : Set X).encard)
  rw [← iInf_and', ← iInf_subtype'', ← coveringNumber] at hC
  exact ⟨C, C.2.1, Set.encard_ne_top_iff.mp (hC ▸ h), C.2.2, hC⟩

  have : Nonempty { s : Set X // s ⊆ A ∧ IsSeparated ε s } := ⟨⟨∅, empty_subset _, .empty⟩⟩
  simp_rw [packingNumber, ← iSup_and', ← iSup_subtype''] at h ⊢

It is defined as the empty set if no such finite cover exists. -/

def minimalCover (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Set X) : Set X :=
  if h : coveringNumber ε A ≠ ⊤ then (exists_set_encard_eq_coveringNumber h).choose else ∅

lemma finite_maximalSeparatedSet : (maximalSeparatedSet ε A).Finite := by

lemma coveringNumber_subset_le (h : A ⊆ B) :
    coveringNumber ε A ≤ coveringNumber (ε / 2) B :=
  calc coveringNumber ε A
    _ = coveringNumber (2 * (ε / 2)) A := by rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ two_ne_zero]
    _ ≤ externalCoveringNumber (ε / 2) A := coveringNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber _ A
    _ ≤ externalCoveringNumber (ε / 2) B := externalCoveringNumber_mono_set h
    _ ≤ coveringNumber (ε / 2) B := externalCoveringNumber_le_coveringNumber _ B

lemma coveringNumber_two_mul_le_of_subset (h : A ⊆ B) :
    coveringNumber (2 * ε) A ≤ coveringNumber ε B :=
  (coveringNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber ε A).trans <|
    (externalCoveringNumber_mono_set h).trans (externalCoveringNumber_le_coveringNumber ε B)

    (h_subset : C ⊆ A) (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    C.encard ≤ (maximalSeparatedSet ε A).encard := by

/-- The maximal separated set is a cover. -/
lemma isCover_maximalSeparatedSet (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    IsCover ε A (maximalSeparatedSet ε A) := by
  intro x hxA
  by_contra h_dist
  push_neg at h_dist
  have hx_not_mem : x ∉ maximalSeparatedSet ε A := by
    intro hx_mem
    specialize h_dist x hx_mem
    simp at h_dist
  classical
  let C := {x} ∪ maximalSeparatedSet ε A
  have hC_subset : C ⊆ A := by
    simp [C, hxA, maximalSeparatedSet_subset, Set.insert_subset]
  have hC_separated : IsSeparated ε C := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst hax
      have hb' : b ∈ maximalSeparatedSet ε A := by simpa [C, hab.symm] using hb
      simpa using h_dist b hb'
    by_cases hbx : b = x
    · subst hbx
      have ha' : a ∈ maximalSeparatedSet ε A := by simpa [C, hab] using ha
      have h := h_dist a ha'
      simp only [mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at h
      rwa [edist_comm] at h
    simp only [singleton_union, mem_insert_iff, hax, false_or, hbx, C] at ha hb
    exact isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet ha hb hab
  refine absurd (hC_separated.encard_le_encard_maximalSeparatedSet hC_subset h) ?_
